mails.subject: Samarbejde med Kanalhuset
mails.body:
Hej,

Vi mødtes kort ved et af jeres arrangementer i sommer, og jeg har tænkt på jer siden. Kystlinjen Netværk arbejder med at forbinde lokale iværksættermiljøer, og vi vil gerne have Kanalhuset med som samarbejdspartner.

Vi kan lave en fælles omtale på vores kanaler, hvis I til gengæld linker til vores medlemsside. Medlemskab af netværket koster 950 kr. pr. måned for jeres medlemmer.

Skriv gerne, hvis I vil have flere oplysninger.

Mvh
Sara Winther
Kystlinjen Netværk
mails.justification: The 'we met at one of your events' claim has no date or detail and the 'collaboration' is a paid membership scheme from an unknown network.

mails.subject: Cutting your software costs by 40 percent
mails.body:
Hello Kanalhuset team,

I noticed your space lists a members' portal and a booking page on the website. Running these usually costs a small space somewhere between 800 and 1,500 EUR a month in licences and upkeep.

Stackbridge builds custom internal tools for coworking operators with our Lisbon-based team. Our standard rate is 35 EUR per hour, and most booking portals are done within six weeks. We can start with a free two-hour audit of what you have today.

Would it be useful to book a 20-minute call next week?

Best,
Owen Faulkner
Business Development, Stackbridge
mails.justification: Cold sales outreach for outsourced software development, personalised with a detail from the public website, from a vendor the space never contacted.

mails.subject: Sponsored content opportunity for Kanalhuset
mails.body:
Dear Colleagues,

The Baltic Commerce Review is a respected digital journal covering regional entrepreneurship and shared workspace trends. In preparing our autumn directory of Copenhagen workspaces, our editorial team came across your website and wished to offer you the opportunity to participate.

We would like to bring the following options to your attention:

1. Standard listing in the directory, including a dofollow link to your site: 120 EUR.
2. Featured profile with a 600-word article, photographs and two backlinks: 340 EUR.
3. Annual sponsorship of the Copenhagen section: 900 EUR.

All articles are prepared by our editorial staff on the basis of information you supply. Our publication is indexed by the major search engines, and listed organisations typically report an improvement in their search visibility within two to three months.

Should you wish to be included, we kindly ask you to confirm your selected package before 10 October so that your entry can be prepared for the edition. Payment details will be supplied on confirmation.

We remain at your disposal for any further information.

Yours sincerely,

Helena Strand
Editorial Relations
Baltic Commerce Review
https://baltic-commerce-review.example/directory
mails.justification: A formal paid-listing and backlink offer presented as an editorial invitation, from a publication the space has no relationship with.

mails.subject: Event Hub: your account will be closed
mails.body:
hi,

Sent from my phone sorry for typos. Your Kanalhuset Event Hub listing has been flagged because the payment for the last 3 events listings did not go thru. Your account will be deactivated in 24 hrs and all upcoming bookings will be cancelled.

Please login and update billing here: https://kanalhuset-eventhub.example/login

Outstanding amount 189 EUR.

Thanks
Daniel Osei
Event Hub Support
Sent from my iPhone
mails.justification: A phishing message imitating an event platform, using the space's name in a lookalike domain and pushing a login on an external link for a payment the space never made.

mails.subject: quick one from Mads 🙂
mails.body:
Hey Kanalhuset crew! 🙌

Mads here, we haven't spoken before but I'm in a members' circle that a few people from Copenhagen coworking spaces are part of, so I thought I'd share this with you directly.

Long story short: a few of us pooled money into a trading group run by a guy called Viktor, who used to work in asset management. It's honestly been wild. Last quarter I put in 2,000 EUR and got back 3,100 EUR in six weeks, no stress, he does all the trading for you. 😎

He's taking a few more people on before the end of October, and spots go fast. Lena (she's in the group too) said your space would be a perfect fit because founders always have spare cash lying around.

The minimum is 500 EUR and you can withdraw anytime, apparently. Here's the sign-up page: https://silverkey-circle.example/join

No pressure at all! But if you do it, mention my name so I get the referral bonus 😅

Anyway, hope the autumn is treating you well!! ☀️

Mads
mails.justification: A casual investment scam with unrealistic returns and a referral bonus, sent by a stranger who vaguely claims to share a circle with coworking spaces.

mails.subject: Gratis webinar tirsdag
mails.body:
Hej! Tirsdag kl. 12 holder vi et gratis webinar om bedre møder for små teams. Se programmet og tilmeld her: https://nordiskwebinarhus.example/moeder
Mvh Nordisk Webinar Hus
mails.justification: A mass webinar invitation from a company the space never signed up with, sent late on a weekend.

mails.subject: Re: your upcoming hiring needs
mails.body:
> Hi, hope you're well, we place seasonal staff in Copenhagen.

Following up on my last note: we have 60 warehouse and event staff ready to start next week. Happy to send CVs to your members. Tessa
mails.justification: The 'Re:' makes it look like a conversation, but the quoted line is the sender's own earlier staffing blast and the space never replied.

mails.subject: Suite à notre rencontre
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Suite à notre rencontre lors de votre événement, je souhaiterais vous proposer un partenariat entre Riveraine Réseau et Kanalhuset. Nous pourrions mutualiser nos communautés. Seriez-vous disponibles pour un appel cette semaine ?

Cordialement,
Camille Roche
mails.justification: No event, date or detail of the supposed meeting is given, and the sender is an unknown network with no existing relationship.

mails.subject: Introduction
mails.body:
Hello,

I am the account executive at Leadforge. We work with coworking operators in Northern Europe to fill their memberships through targeted outbound campaigns.

We build a list of freelancers and small companies in your area, write the messages, and send them for you. Clients usually get between 8 and 15 qualified tour requests a month.

If this is interesting, I can send a case study from a space of about your size. Otherwise, no worries and thanks for reading.

Gabriel Stone
Leadforge
mails.justification: Plain cold outreach for a lead-generation service, from a vendor with no relationship to the space.

mails.subject: Votre site Kanalhuset : améliorations SEO et backlinks
mails.body:
Bonjour,

Je me permets de vous écrire car j'ai consulté le site de Kanalhuset avec attention, et je pense que votre espace mérite une meilleure visibilité sur Google. Vos pages sur les abonnements et les salles de réunion sont bien présentées, mais elles ne sont pas positionnées sur les requêtes que tapent vos futurs membres.

Chez Visibilis, nous accompagnons des lieux comme le vôtre depuis plus de huit ans. Concrètement, voici ce que nous pouvons faire pour vous :

- un audit technique complet de votre site, offert (valeur 450 €)
- la création de 15 backlinks de qualité chaque mois sur des sites partenaires
- la rédaction de deux articles optimisés par mois, publiés sur nos blogs

Notre forfait « Présence locale » est à 620 € par mois, sans engagement de durée, et nous garantissons une hausse du trafic dans les 90 jours. Pour les structures qui répondent avant le 30 septembre, nous offrons le premier mois à 310 €.

Si vous le souhaitez, nous pouvons organiser un appel de 20 minutes pour vous présenter notre méthode et quelques résultats obtenus pour d'autres espaces de coworking en Europe.

Dans l'attente de votre retour, je vous souhaite une excellente journée.

Bien cordialement,
Léa Fournier
Responsable des partenariats, Visibilis
https://visibilis-agence.example
mails.justification: A paid SEO and backlink package, personalised with remarks about the space's website but sent by an agency the space never contacted.
